title: Should AI Decide Your Court Case? This Judge Says Yes
summary: One of England’s top judges, Geoffrey Vos, believes that AI could adjudicate plenty of civil cases. The question, he says, is where the line should be drawn.
llm_summary: England’s senior judge Geoffrey Vos argues that artificial intelligence could handle many routine civil lawsuits, freeing up human courts for more complex matters. He says the key challenge is deciding exactly where to draw the line between cases that can be safely automated and those that still need a human judge’s judgment.
